title: Legora and DiliTrust partner to connect legal AI with contract and entity management for in-house legal teams
summary: A new integration built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP) will let mutual customers search for contracts templates and entity records maintained in DiliTrust and use them to draft and edit directly from Legora.
body_markdown:
Legora the agentic operating system for legal work, and[DiliTrust,](https://www.dilitrust.com/) where in-house legal and governance teams manage their contracts, legal entities and corporate governance, today announced a strategic partnership. A new integration connects Legora with DiliTrust's Contract Management and Entity Management capabilities, so in-house legal teams can search their DiliTrust contract repository, templates and entity records from Legora, while the data remains managed in DiliTrust. Built on the Model Context Protocol (MCP), the integration will be made available to mutual customers through an early access beta.


In-house legal teams are expected to answer the business quickly, whether the question concerns what a contract says or how a subsidiary is owned and governed. Yet that information is usually managed in one system, while lawyers research and draft in another. The partnership is designed to close that gap: legal teams keep managing and approving their contracts and entities in DiliTrust, with the help of Lini, DiliTrust's AI, and they can seamlessly pull the latest versions of these contracts and entity records into Legora as context for drafting, editing, legal analysis, due diligence and more.


The integration reads DiliTrust data without altering it and gives mutual customers four ways to work with it in Legora:


-


**Contract research and summaries:** users can ask questions about a DiliTrust contract, such as its obligations, dates, parties or governing law, or get a summary of its key terms based on the current record in DiliTrust. Across the repository, users on Legora can also see key details for multiple contracts, such as party names and contract types.


-


**Due diligence** **and review at scale** : users on Legora can find contracts by keyword, counterparty, folder or type, and the Legora Agent can display insights across the contracts it finds without the need for manual export.


-


**Drafting** **and negotiation from approved templates and precedent** : users on Legora can search for their organization’s approved DiliTrust templates and use these templates to draft or edit a contract.


-


**Entity, governance and ownership insight:** users can query DiliTrust Entity Management to see details for each entity, such as company type, jurisdiction, shareholders, governance structure and total capital. They can also find the documents filed for an entity and bring them into a review.


"Legal teams are adopting AI fast, and they are still accountable for every answer it gives," said Cyril Godet, VP Legal Expertise and Alliances at DiliTrust. "Our customers manage their contracts, entities and governance in DiliTrust, and that is where those records are kept current, approved and recorded. Legora gives their lawyers a way to research, review and draft from that same data. The more legal teams use AI, the more it matters that the data behind it is kept current in one place that the legal team manages."


"DiliTrust is where many in-house legal teams manage their contracts, legal entities and corporate governance," said Gabriel Quek, Senior Director of Technology Partnerships at Legora. "Those teams shouldn't have to switch systems to find the position taken in a prior contract or check how a subsidiary is owned. With this integration, they can ask Legora, see the details they need, and draft from their own DiliTrust templates."


For in-house legal departments that already rely on DiliTrust, everyday questions about contracts and entities can be answered in Legora and DiliTrust. A legal operations lead can find a specific contract and see its key terms, a corporate secretary can check the shareholders and governance structure of a subsidiary in any jurisdiction, and a transaction team can pull together an entity's details and filed documents before a deal. Any change, approval, or signature still happens in DiliTrust, where the record is kept current. Access follows the permissions set in DiliTrust.


The integration is the first step in the partnership, and Legora and DiliTrust will develop additional features in subsequent phases to better serve in-house legal teams.


##### About Legora


Legora is the agentic operating system for legal work, supporting lawyers in research, review, and drafting across complex matters. It is used by more than 140,000 legal professionals at more than 2,500 leading law firms and in-house legal teams across over 80 markets.


##### About DiliTrust


DiliTrust is the legal operating system that in-house legal and governance teams use to run their work. It keeps a company's entities, contracts, matters and board decisions, and the documents behind them, accurate and under the legal team's control. Their people and Lini, DiliTrust's AI, work from that same data within each capability. Built in Europe, where legal and governance standards are among the most demanding in the world, DiliTrust serves 2,500+ organizations in 65+ countries.
